keywords: EIP-8141 原子批量禁用 approval
summary: EIP-8363 引发的发行讨论扩散，Pooja、trent_vanepps 和 nero_eth 解释 Hegotá 的流程：8 月 6 日截止的是提案，不是入选，选定在 11 月 8 日结束。账户侧，ERC-8366 提出零知识支出策略，ERC-4337 账户、EIP-7702 委托 EOA 等都可按预先登记的策略凭证明放款；EIP-8141 PR 静态禁止原子批量中的 approval 作用域。EF 的 Trillion Dollar Security 资助 WEBCAT 前端校验。

items.topic: 账户侧的支出策略和代理授权
items.title: Magicians：ERC-8366 零知识支出策略
items.note: 12:37（junbeomlee），对应 ERC PR 1929。标准化一组可组合函数，任何持有用户资金的合约（专用托管、智能钱包、ERC-4337 账户或 EIP-7702 委托的 EOA）都能实现，只在零知识证明表明这笔付款满足所有者预先登记的支出策略时才放款。
items.title_en: Magicians: ERC-8366 zero-knowledge spending policies
items.note_en: 12:37 (junbeomlee), with ERC PR 1929. It standardizes a composable function set that any contract holding a user's funds (a dedicated escrow, a smart wallet, an ERC-4337 account or an EIP-7702-delegated EOA) can implement to release those funds only against a zero-knowledge proof that the payment satisfies a spending policy the owner registered in advance.

items.topic: EIP-8141 与 FOCIL 的细化
items.title: EIP-8141：静态禁止原子批量 frame 的 approval 作用域
items.note: （Marchhill）提交。对原子批量的任何 frame（包括终止 frame）静态禁止 approval 作用域，在执行前就消除批内 `APPROVE_PAYMENT` 分歧，不需要回滚 nonce、`max_cost` 或 `sender_approved`；由于 `APPROVE` 要求作用域写在 `frame.flags` 中，检查可以静态完成，退款归最终的 `payer`。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: statically disallow approval scope on atomic-batch frames
items.note_en: (Marchhill), submitted. It statically disallows approval scope on any frame of an atomic batch, including its terminating frame, closing the in-batch `APPROVE_PAYMENT` divergence before execution with no rollback of the nonce, `max_cost` or `sender_approved`; because `APPROVE` requires the scope in `frame.flags`, the check is static, and the refund goes to the final `payer`.

items.topic: EIP-8141 与 FOCIL 的细化
items.title: 新 EIP：FOCIL 资格的 VOPS 档位
items.note: （soispoke）提交，即 EIP-8369。档位 1 保留普通非 blob 交易的现有载荷末尾检查，档位 2 为合格的 frame 交易加入有界的验证重放；PR 说明它取代前一天的 12086。
items.title_en: New EIP: VOPS profiles for FOCIL eligibility
items.note_en: (soispoke), submitted, now EIP-8369. Profile 1 keeps the existing end-of-payload check for regular non-blob transactions, and Profile 2 adds bounded validation replay for eligible frame transactions; the PR says it supersedes the previous day's 12086.

keywords_en: EIP-8141 no approval in atomic batches
summary_en: The issuance debate around EIP-8363 widened, and Pooja, trent_vanepps and nero_eth explained Hegotá's process: the August 6 deadline is for proposals, not inclusion, and selection ends on November 8. On accounts, ERC-8366 proposes zero-knowledge spending policies, so ERC-4337 accounts, EIP-7702-delegated EOAs and other fund holders can release funds against a proof that meets a preregistered policy, and an EIP-8141 PR statically disallows approval scope in atomic batches. The EF's Trillion Dollar Security initiative funded WEBCAT front-end verification.
